consular.mission: Canadian Embassy, Algiers; Australian Embassy, Paris
consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy or consulate in Algeria. The Canadian Embassy in Algiers provides consular help to Australians in Algeria. It can issue Australian provisional travel documents.
